sections.Profile:
"Don Quijote" is a solid-state pinball machine released by Recel S.A. in 1979. The game accommodates up to four players and features two flippers, two pop bumpers, a slingshot, two kick-out holes, three standup targets, two swivel targets, two sets of three-bank drop targets, and a spinning target.

- Manufacturer: Recel S. A.
